arguments.text: Let the pack go, settle into your own steady pace.

text: let_go: holding the pack takes 240 W shaft, 25 pct above critical power, pod reserve would empty in about 600 m of 5800.

arguments.message: pod reserve below 35 pct with far to go: decide hang on or let go of the wash

text: no cue: on the wash at 204 W shaft with 65 pct pod reserve; the boat-model alert is fooled by the wash, so I replaced it with a pod-reserve watch.

arguments.text: Let the pack go, settle to your own steady effort.

text: let_go: wash benefit has faded from 0.36 to 0.09 m/s while 207 W shaft would empty the pod reserve in 1.1 km of 5 km.

arguments.text: Ease a touch now, settle at two forty pace.

arguments.message: shaft power above the pod sustainable level for 30 s

text: ease to 2:40: off the wash at 208 W shaft, pod reserve 34 pct would empty in 770 m of 4600 m; sustainable is about 194 W.
no cue: shaft power is already falling (208 to 202 W in 20 s) toward the 194 W sustainable level; let it settle.

arguments.message: speed at this rate down more than 8 pct vs early race (early race was on a wash, so about 4 pct of fade is the lost wash)
shaft power more than 4 W above the pod sustainable level for 45 s

text: no cue: the fade is mostly the lost wash from early race; shaft power is easing toward the 194 W sustainable level.
no cue: shaft power 193-197 W sits at the 194 W sustainable level; speed drop matches the lower effort, not fatigue.
no cue: shaft power 189 W is just under the 195 W sustainable level, reserve steady at 25 pct, speed holding; leftover goes into the sprint.

arguments.text: Lift the effort a little now, hold it to the finish.

text: push: shaft power drifted to 182 W, 15 W under the 197 W sustainable level, with the pod reserve refilling to 29 pct and 2 km left; fade is explained by the lost wash and lower effort.
no cue: shaft power is rising (184 to 189 W) toward the 197 W sustainable level with 29 pct pod reserve; let it settle.

arguments.text: Ease a touch here, save it for the last leg.

text: ease: 202 W shaft would empty the 23 pct pod reserve in 820 m, before the last leg into the current; ease on this helping current leg.

arguments.text: Last leg, lift the effort now, strong and steady.

text: push: last 1000 m into the current at 184 W shaft while the pod reserve (27 pct) supports about 201 W to the line.
no cue: inside the last 100 m and already sprinting.
